name: Expanded Finesse Training (Ex)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Finesse training class feature

Benefit(s): A rogue with this talent selects one one-handed or two-handed weapon that she is proficient with. She gains the benefits of Weapon Finesse with the selected melee weapon and beginning at 3rd level, she can select this weapon with her finesse training class feature.
